The Cisco C1111-8P is a high-performance, compact Integrated Services Router (ISR) designed for small and medium-sized businesses, branch offices, and ISPs in Bangladesh. With dual WAN support, 8 Gigabit Ethernet ports with PoE, advanced security features, and flexible routing options, it delivers reliable, secure, and high-speed connectivity for modern enterprise networks.


Key Features:

  • Dual WAN Connectivity: Enables load balancing and failover for uninterrupted internet access
  • 8 Gigabit Ethernet Ports with PoE: Powers IP phones, access points, and other devices directly
  • Advanced Security: Built-in firewall, VPN support (IPsec, SSL), and Cisco IOS XE security features
  • Flexible Routing Protocols: Supports OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, and static routing
  • Network Management: CLI, Web GUI, and Cisco DNA Center support for easy monitoring and configuration
  • Compact Design: Space-saving router ideal for office and branch deployment
  • High Performance: Low latency routing for business-critical applications


Technical Specifications:

  • Model: Cisco C1111-8P
  • WAN Ports: 2 x Gigabit Ethernet (dual WAN support)
  • LAN Ports: 8 x Gigabit Ethernet with PoE (Power over Ethernet)
  • Routing Protocols: OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, RIP, Static Routing
  • Security Features: Stateful firewall, VPN (IPsec, SSL), Cisco TrustSec
  • Network Management: Cisco IOS XE, CLI, Web GUI, Cisco DNA Center
  • Throughput: Up to 200 Mbps (with services enabled)
  • PoE Power Budget: Up to 60W total PoE output
  • Interfaces: USB, Console, Ethernet
  • Power Supply: Internal AC power supply
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 40°C
  • Dimensions: 1.73 x 12.4 x 8.4 in (H x W x D)
  • Weight: 3.6 lbs (1.63 kg)
